title: Boros–Moll coefficient log-monotonicity conjectures
statement: Let $P_m(x)$ be the Boros–Moll polynomial, and let $d_i(m)$ be the coefficient of $x^i$ in $P_m(x)$. For every integer $m\ge 4$, define $q_i(m)=\frac{d_{i-1}(m)d_{i+1}(m)}{d_i(m)^2}$ for $1\le i\le m-1$. The conjecture asserts that the sequence $(q_i(m))_{i=1}^{m-1}$ is strictly log-concave; equivalently, $q_i(m)^2>q_{i-1}(m)q_{i+1}(m)$ for every $2\le i\le m-2$.
references: - [Inequalities for Higher-Order Logarithmic Differences of Boros--Moll Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25381) — arXiv — Cindy C. Y. Gu, Yafeng Liu, Matthew H. Y. Xie

progress.label: Open · progress reported
progress.tldr: A 2026 preprint claims major advances on these coefficient conjectures, but the claims have not been independently checked.
progress.summary:
The problem concerns a family of conjectures about Boros–Moll coefficients, including ordinary and infinite log-concavity, ratio monotonicity, and related positivity properties. No original proposer or date is identified in the retrieved sources.

*[ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/0809.0127) · [ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/0806.4333)*

**Known results**

- Ordinary log-concavity, $d_i(m)^2\ge d_{i-1}(m)d_{i+1}(m)$, was proved by Kauers and Paule in 2007.
- A 2010 paper established $2$-log-concavity for every $m\ge 2$.
- Earlier work proved strict ratio monotonicity and the spiral property for $(d_i(m))_{i=0}^m$.
- Infinite log-concavity, stronger ratio-sequence conjectures, and related real-rootedness claims were previously open.

*[research.jku.at](https://research.jku.at/en/publications/a-computer-proof-of-molls-log-concavity-conjecture/) · [algebra.uni-linz.ac.at](http://www.algebra.uni-linz.ac.at/people/mkauers/publications/kauers06g.pdf) · [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1010.0416) · [ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/0806.4333)*

**2026 preprints claiming further proofs**

Preprints by Cindy C. Y. Gu, Yafeng Liu, and Matthew H. Y. Xie, and by other authors, claim proofs of infinite log-concavity and additional conjectures, including real-rootedness and strict infinite log-concavity. The latest reports also claim stronger total-positivity and Hausdorff-moment conclusions, but no independent substantive assessment was retrieved.

*[arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25381) · [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.20653) · [arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.12237)*

Current status (as of October 2026): Ordinary and several higher-order partial properties are established, while the 2026 claims of resolving the remaining conjectures are unverified.

*Caveats. The purported 2026 resolutions come from unrefereed preprints without retrieved expert verification.*
